subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: PER.VT.U.FUND.------COS.P.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-6, one page before the passage where Braxton argues that 'creativity is not separate from the underlying factors which dictate how we move in vibrational and cosmic terms in our actual lives... what is really happening is cosmic.' (C)PER-VT-U-FUND — the *perceived* vibrational universe fundamental, the limit of what humans can apprehend of the universe's vibrational ground — is crossed with COS-P (cosmic particulars). The diagram poses: how does the *perceived* fundamental relate to actual cosmic particulars when the human apparatus of perception is itself involved? Besides the main line to COS-P, two branches leave the subject. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) carries HI-P (high purpose) and TR (transformation), and TR in turn carries DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). MT-INFO (multi-information) carries IF-SPT (infra-spirituality), which in turn carries INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis).
